title: XL Means Extra Load, Not Extra Large
topic: XL on a passenger tire means Extra Load
mechanicTruth: On passenger tires, XL means Extra Load: a load-capability designation tied to reinforced construction and specified inflation/load conditions, not a statement that the tire is physically extra large.

voiceoverScript: XL on a passenger tire does not mean extra large. It means Extra Load. Two tires can share the same size while carrying different load specifications, so replacement fitment is more than matching the biggest numbers.
selectedCaption: XL on a passenger tire means Extra Load, not Extra Large. Size, load specification, speed rating, and vehicle requirements all matter when comparing replacement tires.
